-- Today's dashboard metrics
WITH today_events AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as total_events,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'emergency' THEN 1 END) as emergencies,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'appointment' THEN 1 END) as appointments,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'inquiry' THEN 1 END) as inquiries,
        COALESCE(SUM(estimated_revenue), 0) as revenue_captured,
        COALESCE(AVG(urgency), 0) as avg_urgency
    FROM hvac_events
    WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
),
agent_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as decisions_made,
        COALESCE(AVG(decision_confidence), 0) as avg_confidence,
        COUNT(DISTINCT agent_name) as agents_active
    FROM agent_decisions
    WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT 
    e.total_events,
    e.emergencies,
    e.appointments,
    e.inquiries,
    ROUND(e.revenue_captured::numeric, 2) as revenue_captured,
    ROUND(e.avg_urgency::numeric, 1) as avg_urgency,
    a.decisions_made,
    ROUND(a.avg_confidence::numeric * 100) as confidence_pct,
    a.agents_active,
    -- Calculated metrics
    ROUND((e.total_events * 12)::numeric, 0) as minutes_saved,
    ROUND((e.total_events * 0.004)::numeric, 2) as ai_cost
FROM today_events e, agent_stats a;
